$comment: Regression gates for Stage 1 accuracy. Floors sit BELOW the measured 2026-08 baseline (small-sample margin included) so that a future change which regresses accuracy fails the build. The low floors on GENERIC_SECRET, POSTAL_CODE, URL_WITH_CREDENTIALS, DRIVERS_LICENSE, NATIONAL_ID and TAX_ID reflect measured, documented Stage-1-alone weaknesses awaiting Stage 3 context (M7) and Stage 4 overlap resolution (M8) - they are regression floors, not quality targets. Corpus shape is pinned here so the gate is reproducible. PERSON/ORG/LOCATION are Stage 2 (M6) types: this vitest gate runs Stage 1 only (the unit-test path carries no model), so their floors HERE are 0 by construction; the Stage-2-inclusive gate is the eval CLI's --ner run, with floors in nerPerType.
$commentNerPerType: Stage 2 floors, enforced by the eval CLI's --ner run (not vitest, whose unit-test path carries no model). Set BELOW the 2026-08 M6 benchmark measurement for the selected model (xlm-roberta-base-ner-hrl q8: PERSON P .990/Rp .976, ORG P .809/Rp .883, LOCATION P .674/Rp 1.0) with margin for seed variance between the bench corpus and the CLI corpus. LOCATION's low precision floor reflects the measured street-address type-overlap penalty documented in BENCHMARKS.md, awaiting M8 overlap resolution.
